purpose: blindly select one extreme Rugged cell for fresh-seed confirmation
selection_rule: Prefer cells whose discovery point estimates clear both practical floors and whose three topologies clear the progress gate; maximize the smaller effect surplus, then progress surplus, then prefer lower K and budget. If none are eligible, maximize the smaller of effect and progress surplus with the same deterministic tie-breakers. Discovery confidence bounds never determine selection.
claim_boundary: The 64-block surface is discovery/selection evidence. Only the independent 192-block confirmation can support a positive scripted-mechanism claim.
